test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 20 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following does not fall under the definition of a census town in India?

options.text: Population density 400 persons per km ²
Presence of Nagar Palika, Nagar Nigam etc.
More than 75% of the population is engaged in the primary sector

solution:
The correct answer is__** More than 75% of the population is engaged in the primary sector**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **More than 75% of the population being engaged in** the primary sector does not fall under the definition of a census town in India.
 
• **A census town in India** is a settlement that has the following characteristics:
 
• **A minimum population of 5,000 **
 
• A population density of at least 400 people per square kilometer 
 
• At** least 75% of the main working population is employed outside the agricultural sector **
 
• A census town is not officially notified and administered as a town, but it has urban characteristics. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• As per the 2011 Census, there are 3,784 Census Towns against 1,362 in 2001.
 
• A Statutory Town is one with a municipality, corporation, cantonment board, or notified town area committee.
 
• As per the 2011 Census, there are 4,041 such towns as against 3,799 in 2001.
 
• Conversion of Census towns into statutory ULBs entitles states to Central assistance as per the guidelines of the 14th Finance Commission.
 
• Under Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT), 50% weightage is given to the number of statutory towns in any State/UT in the allocation of funds among States/UTs.
 
• The state with the highest number of census towns in West Bengal with 780 towns.
 
• Mizoram has no census towns.
